quote: Example 5.1. Let the p.d.f.s of r.v.s X(θ) and Y(θ) be fθ(x) = (θ + 1)(1 − e^{−x})^θ e^{−x}, x > 0, θ ∈ (0, 1), and gθ(x) = ((θ + 1)/θ)(1 − e^{−x})^{1/θ} e^{−x}, x > 0, θ ∈ (0, 1), respectively. It is easy to verify that conditions (i) and (iii) of Theorem 3.1 are satisfied. Further, let us assume that the r.v.s Θ1 and Θ2 have p.d.f.s h1(θ) = 1, 0 < θ < 1; and h2(θ) = 2θ, 0 < θ < 1.
